summary: Tested Control Diario Asergrup rebranding + turnos/vehiculos restructuring. Backend: 23/23 new pytest tests + 17/17 legacy tests pass (40/40 total) after fixing a CRITICAL 500 error in POST /api/turnos/{id}/finalizar. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667): verified full flow index -> servicio -> panel with auto turno start, confirmed NO 'Fichar entrada'/'ronda' buttons exist, FINALIZAR TURNO button present, DESCANSO/FIN DESCANSO render in bright white text (theme.color.onSurface) not gray, LLAMADA CENTRALITA modal works end-to-end, Naves tab shows seeded 'Cerámicas' nave, nave detail checks toggle correctly with checked_by/checked_at metadata, ENTRADA/SALIDA NAVE buttons work, 17 linea + 4 frente vehicles seeded with OK/VANDALIZADO badges, vehicle edit modal opens on card tap, add-vehicle modal creates new vehicle with vandalizado detail, Control tab shows EXPORTAR EXCEL/PDF buttons with correct branding. No 'Guardia' text found in codebase (all use 'Vigilante'). app.json name = 'Control Diario Asergrup' confirmed. Could NOT verify the Alert.alert-based 'Finalizar turno' confirmation dialog nor the resumen-turno screen via Playwright/web because react-native-web does not render Alert.alert as a native browser dialog (no window.confirm triggered, page.on('dialog') never fired) - this matches the known limitation flagged by main agent. Backend-level testing (pytest) fully validates the finalizar/resumen data (summary counts, duration, persistence) so the underlying logic is confirmed correct; only the on-web Alert UI trigger could not be exercised.

critical.issue: FIXED DURING TESTING: raised 500 Internal Server Error (TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes) because start_time read back from MongoDB loses tzinfo while end_time uses datetime.now(timezone.utc). This blocked the entire 'Finalizar turno' -> resumen-turno flow, the core deliverable of this iteration. Applied fix in server.py: normalize start_time to UTC-aware before subtracting. Restarted backend and re-ran full suite - all 23 new + 17 legacy tests pass.

integration_issues.flow: Finalizar turno confirmation Alert + resumen-turno navigation
integration_issues.issue: Could not be verified end-to-end via Playwright/web because RN Alert.alert does not produce a browser dialog on react-native-web (no window.confirm/alert call intercepted). Clicking 'finalizar-turno-btn' leaves user on /panel with no visible feedback on web. This is expected per RN-web limitations (already flagged by main agent) but means REAL web users (if the app is ever used via web preview instead of Expo Go/native) would see no confirmation prompt at all and the turno would never finalize from the web build. Recommend testing this specific flow manually in Expo Go / native build, or consider a custom in-app confirmation modal component (not Alert.alert) if web support matters.

react_native_issues.issue: tabBarTestID prop ('tab-panel', 'tab-naves', etc.) set in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx does not render as data-testid on the underlying <a> tab elements in the web build. Not user-facing but reduces testability; had to fall back to a[href="/naves"] selectors.

action_items: Manually verify (or have main agent self-test in mobile/Expo Go mode) the Alert.alert 'Finalizar turno' confirmation -> POST finalizar -> navigate to /resumen-turno -> 'VOLVER AL INICIO' flow, since it could not be exercised via browser automation.
Optional: fix tabBarTestID not propagating to data-testid in web build for future testability.
Optional cleanup: TouchableWithoutFeedback deprecation warning in index.tsx, shadow* style deprecation warnings (non-blocking, pre-existing).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py finalizar_turno had a naive/aware datetime bug (now fixed) - good practice going forward: always normalize datetimes read from MongoDB to timezone-aware UTC before arithmetic.
Nave checks correctly keyed by (nave_id, turno_id, item_name) so they reset per turno as required - verified via pytest that a new turno for the same guard returns all checks unchecked.
Vehicle vandalizado state and photo_path correctly persist across turno start/finalize cycles (not turno-scoped) - verified via pytest.
Vehicle reorder endpoint persists order correctly across reload - verified via pytest (GET after POST /vehiculos/reorder returns same order).
start_turno is idempotent per guard (returns existing active turno instead of creating duplicate) - correct behavior for 'auto-start on service select'.
PDF export correctly uses brand color #E53935 in header per requirement.
No 'Guardia' terminology found anywhere in frontend codebase; all user-facing text uses 'Vigilante'.
DESCANSO/FIN DESCANSO quick actions correctly styled with theme.color.onSurface (bright white/#F2F4F7), not gray/disabled-looking, matching requirement.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% of testable flows (Alert-dependent finalizar->resumen navigation not exercisable on web)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed guards/vehicles/turnos; vehicle test data is cleaned up (deleted) at end of test class. Turno/event test data intentionally left (harmless, guard-scoped with TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Critical finalizar_turno 500 bug is fixed and verified via pytest (23/23 new tests pass covering turno lifecycle, nave-checks reset-per-turno, vehicle CRUD/reorder/persistence). The one flow not verifiable via Playwright/web is the Alert.alert-based 'Finalizar turno' confirmation and subsequent resumen-turno screen, since react-native-web doesn't surface Alert as a browser dialog - main agent should self-test this in Expo Go/native or manually via the emulator/preview if it supports native Alert rendering. All other requested features (drag-handle vehicles, checks reset per turno, branding, terminology, seeded Cerámicas nave with 17+4 vehicles, badges, quick actions) are confirmed working both at API and UI level.
rca_of_issue: finalizar_turno endpoint compared datetime.now(timezone.utc) (aware) against row['start_time'] read from MongoDB via motor, which returns naive datetime objects (pymongo/motor by default deserializes BSON dates as naive UTC datetime unless tz_aware client option is set). Subtracting aware - naive datetime raises TypeError, causing FastAPI to return 500. Fixed by checking start_time.tzinfo is None and attaching timezone.utc before subtraction.
